description: Fusionist’s Endurance Bridge (ACE cross-chain bridge) was exploited on November 22, 2026. An attacker used privileged minting authority to create large amounts of unbacked ACE tokens on BNB Chain and sold them for approximately $1.04M–$2M, crashing the price. Opportunistic traders then bought the cheap tokens and redeemed them via the bridge for real ACE, draining about $3.7M from the bridge reserves. The project issued a security alert advising users to pause ACE transfers, trading, and bridging on BSC.

description: Cross-chain swap protocol Chainflip was attacked on November 21, 2026. The attacker, through a suspected compromise of the aggregate signing key, drained 122.86 BTC, 520.22 ETH, approximately 3.25 million USDC and 758K USDT from its Bitcoin and Ethereum vaults, totaling about $12 million. Some ETH proceeds were quickly sent to Tornado Cash. The project entered full safe mode (disabling deposits, withdrawals and swaps) and offered the attacker a 10% bounty in exchange for returning 90% of the funds.

description: On November 20, 2026, Wagyu’s wrapped Monero token XMR1 was exploited. description: Privacy wallet Fluidkey was attacked on November 19, 2026. Private keys on users’ devices were not compromised. The project paused services and restored them the next day, later releasing a post-mortem.
